title: Lamb and Spinach Mediterranean Casserole
description: A hearty, flavorful casserole perfect for a weeknight dinner, featuring lamb, spinach, and feta cheese.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boned and cut into 1-inch pieces
ingredients.notes: Seasoned with salt, pepper, and oregano

instructions: In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the diced tomatoes, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Add the cooked lamb back into the skillet and stir to combine.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked lamb mixture, spinach, feta cheese, and cubed pita bread.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with additional feta cheese if desired.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the casserole is hot and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
